connectors.name: OBD-II / EOBD 16-pin (SAE J1962 / ISO 15031-3)
connectors.applies_to: Petrol cars sold in the US from 1996 and the EU from 2001, diesels in the EU from 2004; most light vans
connectors.description: Trapezoid 16-pin socket in two rows of 8, usually under the dashboard on the driver's side.
connectors.adapter: Any ELM327-compatible OBD-II adapter (USB, Bluetooth or Wi-Fi).
connectors.support_note: Generic OBD-II scan, live data and clearing are implemented and simulator-tested, not yet verified on real vehicles.

sources.note: Summary of the SAE J1962 pin assignment with cited standards

notes: Pins not listed are left to the manufacturer.
